What shortwave stations can I hear in India?

Tonight's best bets in India include China Radio International on 9675 kHz, Voice of Vietnam on 9840 kHz, Brother Stair on 9400 kHz. Stations beamed at South Asia are the easiest catches; the tables on this page are rebuilt daily from the published schedule.

What time is best for shortwave listening in India?

Evening and night are best for distant stations. In India the evening bands are usually 41, 31 and 25 metres (7, 9.5 and 12 MHz). Many broadcasts aimed at South Asia and the Middle East are strong across the country.

Are there English shortwave broadcasts to India?

Yes. 35 stations broadcast in English toward South Asia this season, including China Radio International, Voice of Korea, Voice of Vietnam, Voice of Turkey.

How do I convert shortwave UTC times to India time?

Add 5 hours 30 minutes to UTC to get India Standard Time. This page already shows times in IST.

Can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Yes. Free WebSDR and KiwiSDR receivers let you tune real shortwave receivers in your browser. See the Listen Online page.
